blocks.text: TORONTO— Anthony Davis had 25 points and 14 rebounds, rookie AJ Dybantsa added 23 points and 12 boards, and the Washington Wizards beat the undermanned Toronto Raptors 103-99 on Wednesday night in the NBA to snap an eight-game losing streak. Canadian Kyshawn George added 20 points for the Wizards, who got off to a promising 4-3 start but hadn’t won since. His 3-pointer with 8:55 left in the fourth capped an 11-0 Wizards run that made it 91-82, Washington’s biggest lead to that point of the game.
